name: Websy and the Time Rogues
description:
About This Game

Evil forces swarm and threaten to destroy all of time. A tiny jumping spider must swing into action to save the past, present and future from multiversal invasion!

Swing Through Levels!

Use webs to swing around at breakneck speed! Dodge armoured enemies and expose their weakpoints to attack.

Shoot Webs!

Choose from an arsenal of web shooters with different behaviours. Fill the screen with bullets, shoot explosive web-rockets, or string together enemies for combo attacks. You can even manipulate the environment, flinging objects and turning hazards into deadly traps.

Build a Thread of Items!

Collect items from different time periods, connecting them in a unique thread of synergies and triggers. Items can trigger their neighbours or grant stacking bonuses, creating varied engines of destruction. Stack huge damage buffs, fill the screen with bullets, or web the entire world!

Battle Through Time!

Explore a world under attack in the past, present and future by the evil Amber Order. Meet quirky characters and piece together stories between runs. Join the Time Rogues and save the flow of time!
short_desc: Swing into battle and smash swarms of enemies with an arsenal of web-shooting gadgets and timeline spanning item builds. Websy and the Time Rogues is an action roguelike with expressive movement and dynamic web abilities. Join the Time Rogues and save the world from being frozen in amber!
